\begin{theorem}\label{independent-identity}
For every $x\in\mathbb{Z}$, \[(x-3)^2=x^2-6x+9\].
\end{theorem}
\begin{proof}Distribute each factor of the square.\end{proof}
\begin{theorem}\label{deliberately-invalid}
For every $x\in\mathbb{Z}$, \[x+1=x\].
\end{theorem}
\begin{proof}This deliberately invalid assertion tests scoped compiler rejection.\end{proof}
